$comment: Curated subset of Anthropic's Messages streaming SSE event bodies. Field names and shapes copied from https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/streaming (accessed 2026-09-25) and cross-checked against fixtures/anthropic/*.sse, which carry real fields (e.g. Message.container, ContentBlock.caller) this schema deliberately leaves unmodeled. Only fields crates/cox-provider/src/anthropic/stream.rs actually reads are declared here, and none are `required` beyond what stream.rs already treats as fatal-if-missing (ProviderError::Parse) -- everything else is optional so an additive API change never breaks parsing. `additionalProperties` is left at its JSON Schema default (true) everywhere on purpose: typify only emits `#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]` when a schema sets `additionalProperties: false`, and stream.rs must keep ignoring fields it does not read.

Message.description: The `message` object carried by `message_start`. Anthropic sends many more fields (id, role, content, container, stop_reason, ...); stream.rs only reads `model` and `usage`.

Usage.description: Token accounting carried by `message_start.message.usage` and `message_delta.usage`. Each event typically populates only a subset of these fields; stream.rs applies whichever are present without blanking the others (AnthropicStream::apply_usage).

ContentBlock.description: The `content_block` object carried by `content_block_start`. Anthropic's documented block kinds are text, thinking, redacted_thinking and tool_use; stream.rs dispatches on `type` and reads `name` only for tool_use. An unrecognised `type` (including redacted_thinking, which cox does not replay yet) is handled by the hand-written state machine, not this schema.

Delta.description: The `delta` object carried by `content_block_delta`. Anthropic's documented delta kinds are text_delta, input_json_delta, thinking_delta and signature_delta; stream.rs dispatches on `type` and reads whichever payload field matches. signature_delta's `signature` field is intentionally left out: stream.rs consumes and drops it (see the module header on why no ProviderEvent carries it yet).

MessageDeltaDelta.description: The `delta` object carried by `message_delta`. Anthropic also sends stop_sequence, container and (under the thinking-binding-controls beta) input_transformations; stream.rs only reads stop_reason and stop_details.

StopDetails.description: `message_delta.delta.stop_details`, populated when stop_reason is "refusal". Both halves are optional and the object itself can be null (claude-api skill, shared/model-migration.md); stream.rs falls back gracefully either way.
